contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (3,000.00) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (3,000.00) AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' (3,000.00)
contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row on p2 is 3,000.00, which equals all three printed figures exactly; the page-subtotal gate and the sum-of-all-pages gate coincide because Schedule A is a single sheet. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 3,000.00 and is the CUMULATIVE cell — never summed as an increment, and equal to Box B here only because this is the filer's first report of the cycle. SEPARATE FILER INCONSISTENCY, TRANSCRIBED AND NOT ADJUDICATED: the same 3,000.00 is ALSO printed in Box A as the Balance at Beginning of the Reporting Period, so the filer books his own money twice, and his Box F then prints 3,000.00 where the box's own printed formula (Box A + Box B) would give 6,000.00. His closing balance nevertheless follows from the figure he printed: 3,000.00 - 2,442.18 = 557.82. None of that touches the contribution side's reconciliation, which is exact against Box B.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (2,442.18) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (2442.18) AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report' (2442.18)
expenditures.detail: +0.80, and it is the FILER'S OWN SUBTOTAL that is high, not a missing row. The 12 Schedule B rows on p3 sum to 690.34 + 31.34 + 25.85 + 31.07 + 70.00 + 48.53 + 20.00 + 631.91 + 11.75 + 56.00 + 717.92 + 106.67 = 2,441.38, against a printed page subtotal of 2442.18 — which is also the printed Total and Box D, all three agreeing with each other and disagreeing with the rows by the same 0.80. EVERY SCREEN THE BRIEF REQUIRES WAS RUN BEFORE CALLING IT A DELTA. (a) ADDENDUM H3 doubled band: the whole amount column was rendered at 900 dpi as one block and the fifteen measured bands hold exactly twelve figures and three empty cells — no band holds two entries, so no row was dropped. (b) ADDENDUM F1.5 / J6 ledger-below-the-last-rule: the strip below the grid renders the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 2442.18' and 'Total Expenditures Made $ 2442.18' labels, not a further entry. (c) A MISSING SHEET is ruled out by the document's own arithmetic: 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' equals this one page's subtotal, so no second Schedule B sheet is unaccounted for. (d) Every one of the twelve amount cells reproduced EXACTLY as recorded in the 900 dpi column crop; these are machine-typed figures on a fillable form, so no glyph is doubtful. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: any of the twelve cells could absorb 0.80, so the closure is not unique (the ADDENDUM C5 / H6 standard), and the 0.80 is equally consistent with an un-itemized item the filer counted in his own total. The delta is retained verbatim as a fact about the document. Correlated-error screen: this is the filer's only filing in this chunk, so the screen returns NOT-CORRELATED-BY-ABSENCE — there is no sibling ledger to compare (the county holds one further Diamond 2022 filing, 4/11/22, which is not in this chunk). Note also that the county's own reviewers ticked the checklist line 'Verify that the subtotal of expenses matches the total of the listed itemized expenditures' on p5 — their check compared the page subtotal to the printed Total, both 2442.18, which is exactly the comparison that cannot see this delta.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only. BOTH conventions were tested and are IDENTICAL here because no in-kind is claimed anywhere on the filing: this is the v. 4.20 blank, whose schedules carry NO in-kind checkbox column, and no row on either schedule carries in-kind wording in its name, purpose or address cell. Monetary-only gives 3,000.00 in and 2,441.38 out, and adding in-kind changes neither figure. The contributions side closes exactly on that basis; the expenditure delta is unaffected by the choice of convention, so in-kind is not a candidate explanation for it.

A black bar sits INSIDE the cover's 'Office' cell, so the filing's own Office field states nothing — this is the documented reason index.csv's 'County Commission Seat A' carries a LOW-confidence, corroboration-only attribution. What this transcription adds, purely as an observation for the coordinator and NOT promoted into any field: the filing does name an office elsewhere on its own face — Schedule B line 1's Purpose cell reads 'Filing fee for Utah County Commissioner'. That is the filer's own first-party statement, on this document, of the body he is running for. It names NO SEAT, so it corroborates 'County Commission' and cannot support any seat letter; the DO-NOT-INFER-A-SEAT rule is untouched. (The candidate's email, vote4stevediamond@gmail.com, is printed in the clear beside the redacted box, which is the same same-filer/same-email corroboration the module already recorded.)

Typed fillable form, printed, wet-signed and rescanned.

TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES INSIDE THIS ONE FILING (ADDENDUM J5): p1 and p3 carry 'Josh Daniels' while p2 and p4 carry 'Amelia Powers Gardner'.

SIX PDF PAGES, FOUR REPORT SHEETS: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B / p4 SUMMARY PAGE / p5 CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST / p6 BLANK VERSO. Every page classified from its own printed header. FOLIATION IS PARTIAL AND UNUSUAL: the cover's Page box reads '1', Schedule A '2', Schedule B '3' — with NO 'of N' on any of them — and the SUMMARY PAGE's Page box is left WHOLLY BLANK. So the sheet that a page-ordinal rule would most want to find is the one sheet this filer did not number.

THIS IS THE CHUNK'S FOURTH CHECKLIST, and it is the PLAIN revision — a two-line 'Website / Network' box with no HOLD line and an unnumbered 'Staff Signature' on each of the two staff copies, both dated 3/31/22 and 3/31/2022, one in red pen and one in blue. That is the same revision bound into Cox 5/9/2022 (at its p5) and a different revision from the 'HOLD + Staff Signature #1/#2' sheet bound into Cox 4/1/2022 and Davidson 4/1/2022 (both at p7). Two revisions, four instances, three different ordinals across the chunk.

A REVIEWER-CHECK OBSERVATION WORTH RECORDING: both staff copies tick 'Verify that the subtotal of expenses matches the total of the listed itemized expenditures?', yet this filing's twelve itemized rows fall 0.80 short of that subtotal. The county's check evidently compares the page SUBTOTAL against the printed TOTAL (both 2442.18) rather than against the sum of the rows — which is precisely the comparison that cannot detect this class of delta. Stated as an observation about what the checklist verifies; no conclusion is drawn about the reviewers.

THE SUMMARY LADDER DOES NOT FOLLOW ITS OWN PRINTED FORMULA, and is transcribed as printed: Box A 3,000.00, Box B 3,000.00, but Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' prints 3,000.00 rather than 6,000.00 — the module's CLAUDE.md already records this filer's Box F as half of A+B. The close, 557.82, follows from the printed Box F minus Box D. Nothing was recomputed.
